{{Capricorn}}
Capricorn 7 is the 35th day of the year in the [[Gaian calendar]]. It is the 7th day of Capricorn, and it is a Sunday. It corresponds to ISO week 5, weekday 7.

Its informal Japanese name is 2宮7日.

On this day, [[Gaiad chapter 35|Chapter 35]] of the [[Gaiad]] is read.

To see structured data on this date see {{q|Q152055}}.

[[Category:Fives]]
** [[Capricorn 7]] Groundhog day<br>

[[Category:Dates with custom text]]
===Chapter summary===
In the Tommotian age, life diversifies into new lineages. Sponges build reefs through Cyath’s coral cities, while predatory forms like Chondrocles hunt with deadly skill. From Lobopus descend three great houses: Velvetclaw, Waterbear, and Ironfoot. Velvetclaw spawns velvet worms and diverse forms like Hallucigena and Annika; Waterbear’s line endures through Ursus and the tiny yet resilient tardigrades; Ironfoot, through Arthur and Opabinia, gives rise to the arthropods who rule Earth. These innovations reshape creation, founding lasting legacies of reefs, hunters, worms, water bears, and arthropods—defining the Tommotian dawn.
